transcript: I have been having severe chest pain for the past two hours. The pain is going to my left arm and I am also sweating. I am also having difficulty breathing. I am very scared.
explanation: Patient described: chest pain, left arm pain, breathlessness, sweating. Duration: 2 hours. Severity: severe. Red flags: cardiac_emergency. Multi-symptom rules: Cardiac Cluster. Classified EMERGENCY -- Cardiology required immediately.
